{{Quote|We just wanted to throw some sand in Norrin's face for what he's done to our professions.|[[Kabalard Vinne]]|<ref name="GNN9" />}}
The '''Raid on the Wroona Stardock''' took place in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]. Shortly before the attack, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Norrin]] of [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]] had declared illegal some [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] guilds, including the [[Guild of Armament Distributors]], the [[Spice Shippers Fellowship]] and the [[Contracts Guild]]. The guild halls were raided by Imperial forces and its members were force to flee Wroona. [[Kabalard Vinne]] of the Guild of Armament Distributors decided to take his revenge of Governor Norrin by attacking the [[Wroona Stardock]]. The raid began when [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteurs]] infiltrated the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Rampant]]'' berthed at the facility and sabotaged its port-most [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drive]]. The subsequent explosion damaged the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and the stardock. This was quickly followed by an attack of [[Snubfighter/Legends|snubfighters]] and two [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] in order to inflict further damage. They were engaged by a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] but the Imperial fighters were all destroyed. Vinne's forces eventually escaped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].
